newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 16.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 16.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* Large April trade deficit of 2.1 billion ringgit drove Kuala Lumpur blue chips down 2.0 percent or 22.03 points to 1,078.38 on Friday. Index could dip toward 1,000, analysts say.
* Wall Street's string of records ignored by Malaysian stocks. Dow Jones up 70.57 points to 7,782.04 on Friday, its sixth consecutive record closing.
* Eye on MBf Capital and Suria Capital after The Edge reports proposed merger deal may be called off.
* "I think the market will continue to drift," said Hudson Teh, head of research at Sarawak Securities. "Most foreign funds are still underweight in this part of the region."
He said the April trade figure alarmed investors because "exports have moderated", but added that one month's data may not be conclusive.
* Maker of gas cookers and household appliances T.H. Hin Corp Bhd set to list on Second Board with offer to sell three million shares at 2.80 ringgit apiece.
* Consumer price index for May up 2.5 percent year-on-year versus 2.6 percent gain in April.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5131/41 a dollar at 1000 GMT Friday against 2.5115/25 at Kuala Lumpur close on Thursday.
